newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TRENCOR , CORONATION, MOBILE FORM ALLIANCE.
newsitem.headline: TRENCOR , CORONATION, MOBILE FORM ALLIANCE.

text.p: South African financial firms Trencor Ltd, Mobile Industries Ltd and Coronation Holdings Ltd said on Thursday they had agreed to form a strategic alliance.
The deal will involve the creation of a new financial services firm Trencor and Coronation Financial Services Ltd (Trencoro) with an initial capital of 200 million rand.
Coronation will acquire 50 percent of Trencoro by issuing 2.67 million new shares at 37.5 rand a share.
The alliance will also see Coronation buy 26 million Mobile shares from Joseph Jowell's Holdings Ltd at a price of 15 new Coronation shares and 37.5 rand a share for every 100 Mobile shares.
A similar offer is to be extended to other shareholders in respect of 25 percent of their holdings.
The firms said the formation of a new financial company would diversify Coronation's activities into the financial sector while providing a good growth opportunity for the Mobile/Trencor group.
The acquisition of a stake in Mobile, which controls 47 percent of Trencor, meant Coronation added a significant amount U.S. dollar denominated income to its earnings, the firm said.
